shorts.title: Ranking Best Jump Rope Fails (#1 is Wild) 💀

gemini.fixes:
1. **Re-hook the First 2 Seconds (00:00–00:02)**
   * **What is seen:** At 00:00–00:01, the video displays a blurry, static shot of Grinch pajama pants and a living room floor with the yellow text overlay "SPOT THE MISTAKE?".
   * **What is heard:** A robotic AI voiceover asks, "Can you spot the mistake before it happens?".
   * **Fix:** Scrap this visual setup entirely. Viewers swipe away instantly because there is no jump rope visible. Start at 00:00–00:02 with a 1.5-second high-stakes, real jump rope fail clip cut right before the impact, paired with a loud crash sound effect and bold text ("#1 IS INSANE 💀") to grab immediate attention.

2. **Replace Fake/Game Clips with Real Jump Rope Fails & Fix Pacing (00:02–00:17)**
   * **What is seen:** Clip #5 (00:02–00:04) shows a tiny, low-resolution windowed video; Clip #4 (00:05–00:07) is an AI-generated animated cat; Clips #3 (00:08–00:10)
